title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Fulfillment Note: How a Free Replacement Travelled
content:
## Fulfillment rate card note: the replacement's own service

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy expedited shipment that was replaced, the portion of the booked fee returned is adjusted by how the replacement travelled: half when the replacement went out overnight at no charge, three quarters when it went out two-day at no charge, and no adjustment when it went out by standard or cold-chain shipping. The adjustment multiplies the portion of the booked fee being returned.

The service read is the shipping method on the replacement shipment's own record.

### Adjustment by the replacement's service

| Replacement went out | Multiplier on the returned portion |
|---|---|
| Overnight, at no charge | 0.5 |
| Two-day, at no charge | 0.75 |
| Standard | no adjustment |
| Cold-chain | no adjustment |

### Hypothetical illustrations (returned portion of 20.00)

- Replacement sent overnight: 20.00 is multiplied by 0.5, giving 10.00.
- Replacement sent two-day: 20.00 is multiplied by 0.75, giving 15.00.
- Replacement sent standard: 20.00 stands.
